title: External validation of deep learning-derived 18F-FDG PET/CT delta biomarkers for loco-regional control in head and neck cancer.
summary: External PET/CT validation links learned delta biomarkers to regional control in a separate cancer cohort; interpretation remains retrospective and noncausal.
ai_technology: Deep-learning PET/CT segmentation produces delta biomarkers evaluated against regional control in an external head-and-neck cancer cohort.
organization: Department of Clinical Physiology and Nuclear Medicine, Rigshospitalet, Copenhagen, Denmark; Department of Clinical Medicine, University of Copenhagen, Copenhagen, Denmark

evidence.tested: External PET/CT validation links learned delta biomarkers to regional control in a separate cancer cohort; interpretation remains retrospective and noncausal.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning PET/CT segmentation produces delta biomarkers evaluated against regional control in an external head-and-neck cancer cohort.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
